subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should OpenClaw migrate existing numeric config backups into the datetime scheme, or preserve them alongside datetime backups until they naturally age out?
rationale: The linked request asks for datetime filenames but also requires migration safety, and either preserving legacy slots or converting them changes the visible backup set users rely on for recovery.

options.title: Convert Numeric Backups
options.body: Use file metadata or a deterministic fallback order to move existing `.bak.N` files into the datetime retention set without losing rollback depth.

options.title: Preserve Numeric Backups Temporarily
options.body: Keep `.bak.N` files valid and hardened until the datetime ring reaches full capacity, then prune them under a documented migration rule.

options.title: Use Doctor Migration
options.body: Defer runtime cleanup until `openclaw doctor --fix` owns legacy backup conversion explicitly.

recommendation.title: Convert Numeric Backups
recommendation.body: Use file metadata or a deterministic fallback order to move existing `.bak.N` files into the datetime retention set without losing rollback depth.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent visible history on the config recovery surface and committed the backup hardening behavior now being changed.
